constructor
· intros h
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ v₁ := by
    intro x
    exact (le_zero_add (v₁ x)).trans (le_trans (le_zero_add (v₁ x)) h)
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ v₂ := by
    intro x
    exact (le_zero_add (v₂ x)).trans (le_trans (le_zero_add (v₂ x)) h)
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
· intros ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  have h_sum : 0 ≤ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ := by
    intro x
    cases x with a b
    exact le_trans (le_zero_add (v₁ a)) (le_trans (le_zero_add (v₁ a)) h₁)
  exact h_sum
